Dragonbone Boko Bows go unnamed in {{AoC}}. ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Bow |strength = 24 |durability = 30 |flammable = Yes |magnetic = No |buoyant = Yes |conductive = No |guardian = No |throw = |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Dragon Bone Boko Bow}} Dragon Bone Boko Bows are [[Bow]]s used by high-tier [[Bokoblin]]s on [[Hyrule Ridge]] and in [[Hyrule Field]]. They are [[Boko Bow]]s that have been reinforced with fossils that were handpicked by Bokoblins. Because of this, they are known to have a respectable firepower. They belong to the [[Bokoblin Gear]] equipment archetype, which is a series of [[Weapon]]s created by Bokoblins.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 174}} Due to being made of wood, Dragon Bone Boko Bows will burn and eventually disintegrate if exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. They will also float if dropped in [[Water]]. Unlike metal [[Weapon]]s, they do not attract [[Lightning]] during [[Thunderstorm]]s, nor do they conduct [[Electricity]]. If scanned with the [[Amiibo (Ability)|amiibo]] [[Rune]], the {{BotW}} Series Bokoblin [[amiibo]] has a chance to spawn a [[Treasure Chest]] containing a Dragon Bone Boko Bow, along with other [[Bokoblin Gear]]. {{BotW Bow Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Bow_027" |Life = 30 |Power = 24 |Range = 20.0 |SpHitActor = "" |SpHitRatio = 2.0 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMin = 4 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMax = 8 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 3 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 6 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMin = 9 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMax = 16 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 7 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 15 |PoweredSharpAddSpreadFire = false |PoweredSharpAddZoomRapid = false |PoweredSharpAddRapidFireMin = 1.1 |PoweredSharpAddRapidFireMax = 1.3 |ArrowName = "" |IsLeadShot = false |LeadShotNum = 5 |LeadShotAng = 20.0 |IsRapidFire = false |RapidFireNum = 3 |ArrowGravity = -9.8 |ArrowChargeRate = 1.0 |ArrowReloadRate = 1.0 }} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{TotK Item Properties/Store |type = Bow |strength = |durability = |flammable = |magnetic = |buoyant = |conductive = |guardian = }} {{Compendium/Extract/TotK|Dragonbone Boko Bow}} {{Stub|TotK}} ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} Dragonbone Boko Bows are wielded by Black Bokoblins and Silver Bokoblins.
